question: After the pacing bug is fixed, should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either behavior, but the product choice trades future recoverability against a clearer terminal operator state for ambiguous delivery rows.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: Merge after the pacing repair if maintainers want no-adapter ambiguous entries to stay recoverable until adapter reconciliation or broader delivery-ledger work ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery consistency design is settled.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a visible doctor, UI, or API path before making ambiguous entries remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: Merge after the pacing repair if maintainers want no-adapter ambiguous entries to stay recoverable until adapter reconciliation or broader delivery-ledger work ships.
